caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass goblet centrally positioned on a flat surface. The goblet has a round bowl with vertical grooves or lines, a short stem, and a circular, slightly domed base. The glass is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting the use of pencil or ink wash on an off-white or light beige background. Shadows and highlights are visible on the glass and its base, indicating transparency and reflective qualities. There are no other objects in the drawing, and the background is plain and unadorned, with only the suggestion of a tabletop where the goblet stands.
title: Glass
